title: Bosphore 1819 — searchable 1819 Bosphorus map

title: Meng To — Japanese river-valley boat scene
description: A playable Three.js riverboat ride through a feudal Japanese mountain valley with day-night weather, painterly water, and a self-poling boat, generated with Claude Opus 5.5.
notes: @MengTo, 2026-09-23. ~6.4k likes / 446k views at fetch. Follow-up ship scene: https://x.com/MengTo/status/2103122947133309311 (live https://ship.mengto.here.now).

title: Clearwater — photoreal WebGL2 shallow water
description: A single-file WebGL2 photoreal shallow-water demo with FFT waves, interactive ripples, and caustics, co-authored with Claude Opus 5.5 and released as open source.
notes: @Aurelien_Gz. Initial water one-shot 2026-09-22 (https://x.com/Aurelien_Gz/status/2102479887495758076); OSS drop 2026-09-23. Commit co-authored 'Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context)'.

title: Opus 5.5 vs Astra motion-design showreel
description: Kirill Sh gave Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra the same one-shot résumé showreel prompt; Opus wrote a Python/Skia plus Blender pipeline and produced a 15-second code-drawn motion piece.
notes: @shneural, 2026-09-24. ~4.1k likes / 690k views. Making-of: https://x.com/shneural/status/2103472385563459833 (1h 32m, $81 API).

title: Deedy — 3blue1brown-style paper explainer
description: Deedy used Claude Opus 5.5 to generate an eight-minute 3blue1brown-style video summary of a research paper, illustrating the model's code-rendered explainer-video capability.
notes: @deedydas, 2026-09-24. ~4.8k likes / 271k views. Related IKEA 3D instructional: https://x.com/deedydas/status/2103174501345493197. Earlier launch-video post (2026-09-23): https://x.com/deedydas/status/2102787937482252537.

title: Foldline — watercolor 3D music driving

notes: @chetanankola, 2026-09-24. ~1.3k likes. Follow-up harbor town: https://x.com/chetanankola/status/2103393323520299428 (2026-09-25).

title: Endor Labs — Opus 5.5 Agent Security League
description: Endor Labs ran Claude Code with Opus 5.5 on the Agent Security League and reported 68.7% functional code, 33.5% secure code, and a $116 full-run cost versus Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.
notes: Luca Compagna, published 2026-09-24. Independent security/functionality harness, not a vendor launch table.
